_readme: Hand-edited. Bills whose number is carrying a different bill's text (a 'vehicle swap'). One entry per swap: bill is the vehicle, carries is the bill whose text it now holds, label names that bill, since is the date the swap was first reported (YYYY-MM-DD), source is a page that says so. Bill ids are <congress>-<type><number>, as in curated.json. Every bill listed here is always kept on the site. Nothing writes to this file automatically.
